item.name: PartsBase
item.summary: Search aviation parts, read market prices, send and answer RFQs and upload inventory on PartsBase.
item.description:
Connect workflows to PartsBase, the aviation parts marketplace, through the PartsBase API. Everyday steps send an RFQ, read the market prices of a list of part numbers and read the RFQs your company received for any period.

Each of the 23 callable operations of the PartsBase API documentation has its own step: real-time and batch part search, market and MRO pricing, government data, RFQs and quotes, inventory upload and API consumption. Amounts are exact decimals. A connection is one set of PartsBase API credentials.
item.setup_summary: Ask your PartsBase account manager for API credentials, add the client id, client secret and API key to the connection and run the connection test.
